बॉलीवुड में शाद रंधावा का जलवा अब एक अलग ही लेवल पर पहुंच गया है भाई लोग! 🔥
27 नवंबर को बॉक्स ऑफिस पर होने वाला है बड़ा क्लेश, क्योंकि इस दिन आ रही हैं दो अलग-अलग फिल्में। 🍿
एक तरफ है आयुष्मान खुराना की साफ-सुथरी फैमिली एंटरटेनर Yeh Prem Mol Liya। 🎬
दूसरी तरफ है इमरान हाशमी की मास एक्शन फिल्म Gunmaaster G9। 💥
सोर्स का दावा है कि शाद रंधावा का Gunmaaster G9 में एक बहुत ही अहम रोल है। 🕶️
अपने 20 साल के करियर में ऐसा पहली बार होगा जब शाद की दो फिल्में एक ही दिन रिलीज होंगी! ✌️
बता दें कि Gunmaaster G9 का 2 मिनट 40 सेकंड का ट्रेलर कल 11 नवंबर को पुणे के एक मल्टीप्लेक्स में लॉन्च होगा, जिसे CBFC से A सर्टिफिकेट मिला है। 📢
क्या आप 27 नवंबर को पहले कौन सी फिल्म देखने जाएंगे, Yeh Prem Mol Liya या Gunmaaster G9? 🎟️

ctx.text:
Shaad Randhawa has been a lucky charm since his debut film, Woh Lamhe (2006). He was then seen in other memorable films like Awarapan (2007), Aashiqui 2 (2013), Ek Villain (2014), etc. In 2025, he was the only common actor in the sleeper successes Saiyaara and Ek Deewane Ki Deewaniyat ; that's when he became a sensation on the internet and finally got his due. Earlier this year, he appeared in just one shot in Awarapan 2 , and it was enough to generate whistles and hoots from moviegoers. Last year, it came to light that Shaad Randhawa had signed Sooraj Barjatya's Yeh Prem Mol Liya , starring Ayushmann Khurrana and Sharvari. The film releases on November 27 and will clash with Gunmaaster G9 . Bollywood Hungama has learned that Shaad is a part of the latter film as well.
In other words, Shaad will once again reunite with Emraan Hashmi after Awarapan and Awarapan 2 . Interestingly, last month, Shaad Randhawa posted a picture in which he could be seen posing with Emraan Hashmi and Gunmaaster G9 's director, Aditya Datt. In the caption, he wrote, ‘#GunmasterG9 ... Yeh film mein bhi ghuss jao kya?? Kya bolte bhai log?’. Many assumed that he was joking and had probably just paid a visit to Emraan and Aditya on the sets of Gunmaaster G9 , with no actual role in the film.
However, a source told Bollywood Hungama , “Shaad Randhawa has a crucial role in Gunmaaster G9 . The makers approached him and he was too happy to be a part of it. He shares a great camaraderie with Emraan off-screen as well and hence, the whole team was happy to have him on board.”
This is the first time in Shaad Randhawa’s 20-year-old career that he’ll have two releases on the same day. Both films are poles apart – while Yeh Prem Mol Liya is a clean family entertainer, Gunmaaster G9 is a massy musical actioner.
Gunmaaster G9 ’s trailer will be unveiled tomorrow, November 11, as announced by the makers. The promo is 2 minutes and 40 seconds long and has received an ‘A’ certificate from the Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC). Earlier in the day, Bollywood Hungama reported that the trailer will be launched in a grand fashion at a multiplex in Pune.
